title: Check Creator Sample Eligibility
label: TIKTOK SHOP · API REFERENCE
subtitle: Updated 2026-10-15
html:
Path: /affiliate_creator/202412/samples/labels

Method: [GET]

Function Description

Check if a creator can apply for a sample of a specific product.

Common Parameters

For common parameters, refer to How to call TikTok Shop APIs - Common Parameters

Properties Location Type Require Sample Properties description
content-type header string Y application/json Allowed type: application/json

Request Query Parameters

Properties Type Require Sample Properties description
app_key string Y 38abcd Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.
sign string Y 5361235029d141222525e303d742f9e38aea052d10896d3197ab9d6233730b8c Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.
timestamp int Y 1623812664 Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.
product_id string Y 1729480364147774364 The TikTok Shop product identifier.

Request Sample

Query

https://open-api.tiktokglobalshop.com/affiliate_creator/202412/samples/labels?app_key=123abc&sign=5361235029d141222525e303d742f9e38aea052d10896d3197ab9d6233730b8c&timestamp=1625484268&product_id=1729480364147774364

Response Parameters

Properties Type Sample Properties description
code int 0 The success or failure status code returned in API response.
message string Success The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.
request_id string 202203070749000101890810281E8C70B7 Request log
data object Specific return information
^label object Creator applicable sample label information.
^^can_apply bool true Whether the authenticated creator can apply for a sample of the specified product.
^^status string ONGOING Status indicating whether the creator has applied for a free sample of the specified product.
  • UNKNOWN: The application status is unknown.
  • TO_APPLY: The creator has not applied for a free sample of the product.
  • ONGOING: The creator has applied for a free sample but has not completed sample fulfillment.
  • COMPLETE: The creator has applied for a free sample and completed sample fulfillment. | ^^application_id |string |86427198341982134 |Sample Application ID. only appear when the creator has already applied this product. | ^^reach_limit |bool |true |If the creator has reached the sample application upper limit. | ^^sample_product |object | |The sample product information. | ^^^sample_sku_list |[]object | |The sample product SKU information. | ^^^^id |string |1731055098570377347 |The SKU identifier. | ^^^^sale_property_value_ids |string |7068196393634072325 |The SKU property value identifiers joined with underscores (_) in the same order as the entries in sale_properties. | ^^^^price |object | |SKU price information. | ^^^^^amount |string |7588986 |The SKU price in major units of the currency specified by currency, represented as a decimal string. | ^^^^^currency |string |USD |The price currency code. | ^^^^sale_properties |[]object | |The SKU property information. | ^^^^^id |string |100000 |A SKU property identifier, short for "Stock Keeping Unit Property ID", is a specific identification code assigned to a particular property or characteristic of a SKU.(i.e: "100000" means "color") | ^^^^^name |string |color |The SKU property name. | ^^^^^value_id |string |7425668826861520646 |The SKU property value identifier is an identification code related to the specific values of the properties of a Stock Keeping Unit (SKU). When a SKU has certain properties like color, size, etc., each possible value for those properties has its own unique SKU property value identifier. For instance, if the property is "color" and the possible values are "red", "blue", "green", then "red" would have its own SKU property vvalue identifier, "blue" would have another one, and so on. | ^^^^^value_name |string |Default |The SKU property value name. | ^^^^is_available |bool |true |Whether this SKU is available for the creator to apply for as a sample. | ^^^^unavailable_reason |string |IS_PREORDER |The reason code associated with SKU sample availability. Interpret a specific unavailability reason only when is_available is false. UNKNOWN can also be returned when is_available is true because no unavailability reason applies. Possible values:
  • IS_PREORDER: The product is a preorder product and does not support free samples.
  • IS_GIFT: The product is a gift and does not support free samples.
  • OUT_OF_STOCK: The product is out of stock.
  • EXCEED_CB_PRICE_THRESHOLD: The SKU price exceeds the applicable cross-border price threshold.
  • ALREADY_APPLYED: The creator has already applied for this SKU.
  • UNKNOWN: No mapped unavailability reason is available. |
